name: Anthony Cello
source:
A youthful-looking secretary and bodyguard to Benedict who still bears traces of innocence.

Raised as a child soldier in war zones, he possesses excellent combat skills, but when it comes to administrative work, he’s prone to mistakes.

His days are filled with constant stress trying to keep up with Benedict's antics.

Part of the PHOENIX mafia

[Modified from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595800/ROAD59_A_Yakuzas_Last_Stand/]Steam page[/url]]
